Title: Infernal Choice to untap question for LSJ

Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
Okay,

Midget is tapped at the start of the turn

The player untaps midget, fails to remember to pay the pool for
infernalism.

Later in the turn the player recalls that they did not pay the
infernal penalty.

What is the proper procedure:
1) Rewind as the player failed to play penalty... player can choose to
pay penalty or keep midget untapped
2) Paying the pool is optional, Midget is tapped

3)other...

I'm guessing 1 but I'm rusty on this on.

John P.
Winnipeg

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.

Paying the pool is optional, but untapping without paying the pool is illegal.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:

>John P. wrote:
>> What is the proper procedure:
>> 1) Rewind as the player failed to play penalty... player can choose to
>> pay penalty or keep midget untapped
>> 2) Paying the pool is optional, Midget is tapped
>> 3)other...
>> I'm guessing 1 but I'm rusty on this on.
>
>Correct.

Although "other" will turn up if too much of the turn has gone on to
rewind, at which point you fudge as best as you can.

That might well be "pay the pool late, and warn the player not to do it
again". I would be disinclined to let the player say, if it applies,
"Well, Midget hasn't acted yet, so I'll put him back to tapped" if other
minions had already acted and it was too far gone to rewind. At that
point, the player has probably extracted relevant information from other
players about the state of their blocking defences and so on.
